scope: PreferencesDialog and directly constructed settings panels only
limits: No native launch, tests, service action, real profile or private vocabulary read.
Lexical helper calls may include conditional controls or comments; they are discovery candidates, not a completed semantic control inventory.
Feature IDs without a direct mapping are not declared absent from the product.
Source consumers do not prove persistence success, complete reset semantics or runtime acceptance.

Revision 4 corrects two preprocessor-dependent helper argument extractions and adds the external-editor selection consumer. All 85 settings helper candidates were checked for the same conditional-argument extraction defect; downstream consumers remain unverified unless explicitly traced.
This snapshot remains bound to the stated source commit. Later corrections are recorded separately and do not silently move its anchors.
